svg.title: proposed fixed roster network topology
svg.desc: Top-to-bottom trust zones, logical endpoints and role instances. Communication planes are listed explicitly to avoid ambiguous crossing connections. Physical placement is stated separately.

g.text: One serve.internal per role instance • deployment-selected socket or host/port • exact maintenance instances
PLACEMENT EXAMPLE | Replica mechanisms and qualification are separate; no capacity or production claim
Permanent or temporary name binds to current tenant/access policy
L4 transport routing, not application authority
Forwards to the declared trusted edge; peer/source-address behavior must be measured
TLS + Host / client identity / access-policy boundary
nginx — TLS termination and logical routing
DATA paths / socket upgrades; optional gateway decision adapter has its own contract and acceptance
API versions are internal adapters, not deployments
Equivalent REST replicas; explicit maintenance participants
INTERNAL LISTENER: one serve.internal per role instance; role code fixes its contracts (decided 2026-11-10).
Socket or host/port is a binding choice. Service routing never substitutes for exact per-instance lifecycle addressing.
Durability, recovery and effective grants remain explicit
Joined acceptance retains its own source and scope
OIDC IdP ↔ optional shared human-session integration: separate current-authority adapter; no implicit DATA/root grant.
Communication planes — exact bindings, separate from placement
TLS public ingress; tenant selection, current access policy and client authority
still apply. Public operator ingress is forbidden.
socket-authority on each replica serve.internal; the binding selects routing.
Deployment controls access; existing tenant/client authority remains.
Same alarm-delivery contract over selected binding. Qualify the selected remote
binding. Realtime replication needs separate fanout ownership.
lifecycle-participant on each instance serve.internal. Complete roster and pinned
incarnation remain mandatory; a load-balanced sample is insufficient.
Proposed health/readiness/metrics contract on serve.internal with fixed
method/path registration and operation-specific lifetime rules. No metrics API is
Optional JSON/status/header projection of existing application authority for
gateway consumers. Direct app-to-app APIs keep the same authority without a
mandatory gateway hop or authentication redesign. Message/write gates remain.
Effective per-role PostgreSQL grants; scoped API/secret-provider Vault access. No
blanket all-role database, Vault or artifact-store authority.
Separately authenticated listener or admitted edge route. Optional OIDC requires
its own joined provider/session acceptance; operator control remains private.
ownership-operations on the operator plane (ADMIN_HOSTNAME/ADMIN_PORT) with its
own ownership_operator identity; not a lifecycle participant and not scaled with
Qualify the selected binding, exact replica roster and operating limits; use release records for current work state.
Acceptance: public/private isolation, no self-blocking control drain, exact roster, replacement, ambiguity and pool/load bounds.
No dynamic API membership, replicated realtime or production/HA claim. MT-EVALUATOR-PARTITION is separate M7 work.
